![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Update the sorting in `countBy` to use the strict byte-order comparison function instead of the removed `compareNatural` helper.

```suggestion
  return Object.fromEntries([...counts.entries()].sort(([left], [right]) => compareByteOrder(left, right)));
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Avoid using Intl.Collator with an undefined locale for sorting, as it can introduce locale-sensitive discrepancies across different runtime environments. Instead, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering.
</details>
Fixed in 45e664fee: countBy now sorts generated summary keys through the same byte-order comparator.
Fixed in 45e664fee: row and posture-delta ordering now use strict question_key byte-order comparison, with the locale/numeric collator removed and regression coverage added.
Fixed in 45e664fee: blocker normalization now handles string, code, blocker_id, and source_blocker_code entries without object blocker IDs, and the behavior is covered by regression tests.
